scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,red,cyan "npm run dev -w @hand-sign/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @hand-sign/api" "npm run dev -w @hand-sign/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @hand-sign/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @hand-sign/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hand-sign/web -w @hand-sign/api
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run check -w @hand-sign/web && npm run build -w @hand-sign/api
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:shared && npm run deploy -w @hand-sign/web
